headers.//: JS and CSS must revalidate. index.html versions its entry points (js/main.js?v=1) but an ES module's OWN imports carry no query string, so ./distractors.js is fetched unversioned — marking it immutable pins a returning visitor to stale modules for a year, with a fresh main.js importing year-old dependencies. This bit seventh-floor and it bit this project too: production served an updated distractors.js while the browser kept running the cached one. Revalidation is cheap (ETag -> 304); a silent mixed build is not.
Genuinely immutable: content-addressed by filename, never edited in place.
